meta.auditor: fresh-session subagent (clean context, no implementation history)
meta.baseline: commit 8fcbf0c; root pnpm run check, app/pi pnpm run verify:fast and pnpm run scale green; full e2e/visual/shots suites not re-run
inputs: all 21 docs/screenshots/pi-agent-*.png files (read directly, not via review notes)
live app at http://localhost:5175 with PI_LOCAL_FEED=1
meta.method: Every gallery PNG inspected first. Live routes then driven in headless Chromium through Playwright with __pi hooks and DOM measurements (getBoundingClientRect, getComputedStyle, commandMode, viewport). Findings use tracked PNG paths as evidence plus a reproduce recipe; no review.json verdict was copied as evidence.

severity_scale.high: core information unreadable in a shipped default state
severity_scale.medium: meaningful task friction or occlusion in a default/opt-in state
severity_scale.low: polish or a known accepted limitation worth recording

findings.observation: The bottom-left HUD readout is effectively invisible: computed #hud color is rgb(22,22,22) over a #canvas background of rgb(5,10,18), a 1.1:1 contrast ratio. The text 'execution/auto · flat/turn · settled' is nearly absent from the gallery PNG. Cards, flux edges and the light-theme field still read; only the HUD value is wrong. The HUD remains grayscale, as required, so this is a token-value failure, not a color-language failure.
findings.reproduce: page.goto('/?shot=light-theme'); getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('#hud')).color; getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('#canvas')).backgroundColor; contrast ratio 1.1:1 computed from those two values.
findings.suggested_change: Bind #hud to a grayscale token that stays light over the dark canvas in both themes, or give it a small opaque square backing using the existing canvas token. No blend modes or blur.

findings.observation: After opening the drawer with #proof-line, all 19 preset/experiment rows are plain <summary> elements with a measured height of 18px (range 18-55px), far below the 44px target used by the rest of the HUD. The drawer leaves the graph visible, but the launch targets are small and give no square-surface affordance.
findings.reproduce: page.goto('/?shot=catalog'); page.locator('#proof-line').click(); evaluate getBoundingClientRect().height for every '#catalog .catalog-card summary'; minimum 18px, count 19.
findings.suggested_change: Make each catalog summary a padded square row with at least a 44px hit area and a visible chip marker consistent with the card grammar.

findings.area: legibility after grid packing / narrow and dense shots
findings.observation: Grid-packed child cards cover about 40-47% of their parent card area in the fit shots (DOM rect measurement). At mid/near octaves on the 900px canvas and in the dense-type and policy shots, primary labels truncate to 'Tur...', 'assist...' and 'appr...'; parent metadata/bar rows disappear under the child. The role of a truncated card is ambiguous without the transcript, so packing reduces information density rather than adding it.
findings.reproduce: page.goto('/?shot=fit-narrow-near') at 900x1000; list textContent and getBoundingClientRect of '#canvas [data-rung]' and compute pairwise intersection over the smaller card area; largest parent/child fractions 43-47%.
findings.suggested_change: Reserve a minimum text-lane width for primary labels before packing children, or use unambiguous short role tokens. Raising minLabelPx alone will not fix width truncation.

findings.area: legibility and overlap after grid packing / node detail
findings.observation: The focus lens is anchored directly over the revealed 'test failed' node: its detail panel overlaps the source card by 65% of the smaller rect and covers the failed status chip and part of the Turn 5 card. The lens tabs themselves are 44-59px tall, so the issue is placement, not hit area.
findings.reproduce: page.goto('/?shot=node-detail'); compare getBoundingClientRect of '#focus-lens' with the '#canvas [data-rung]' whose text starts 'test failed'; largest overlap 65% of smaller rect. Tab sizes measured in the same run: 52x44, 45x44, 59x44, 59x44, 44x44.
findings.suggested_change: Bias lens placement into free canvas space while keeping the 1px connector, or offset/dim the source card when the lens is pinned.

findings.area: status, direction and causality / remaining cross-unit diagonals
findings.observation: Status glyphs and arrowheads do read without a legend, but the long cross-unit flux filaments ('approve' to 'Unit', 'Run' to 'read') span the whole canvas and cross unrelated unit cards. The causal relation is visible as a filament yet cannot be followed through the intervening scopes. This is the topology limitation already acknowledged in TODO6 section 1, not a regression from ADR 0016.
findings.reproduce: page.goto('/?shot=cockpit') at 1600x1000 and follow the translucent ribbon from the 'approve' card to the right-hand 'Unit' scope; also visible in docs/screenshots/pi-agent-node-detail.png.
findings.suggested_change: Bundle cross-unit filaments or tint them by source scope so the relation stays traceable; preserve the relation instead of deleting it.

findings.area: legibility and space in narrow fit shots
findings.observation: At a 900px viewport the command bar wraps onto two rows (focus moves to the second row), moving the canvas top from about y=62 on wide shots to y=112 and reducing vertical room for the graph. The status chip text itself is not clipped (292x26, scrollWidth == clientWidth), so this is a space cost, not text loss.
findings.reproduce: page.goto('/?shot=fit-narrow-mid') at 900x1000; measure '#command-bar' row count and '#attention' rect; compare with '/?shot=fit-wide-mid' at 1600x1000.
findings.suggested_change: Collapse secondary HUD labels into the settings menu at narrow widths so the command bar stays on one row.

findings.observation: At bounded depth 3 the inner graph chips render as roughly 6-10px rectangles with sub-8px labels. Spokes, ports and status color are visible; chip names are not. The settled and intermediate frames pass their gates, but the gallery PNG does not communicate which inner chip is which. This disagrees with the existing 'depth-3 legible' note on label legibility only.
findings.reproduce: page.goto('/?shot=recursion'); open the INNER tab (already pinned in the shot) and zoom the PNG; measure the text bounding boxes of '#focus-lens' inner chips.
findings.suggested_change: Reveal inner chip names on hover/focus or enlarge the inner lens within the existing 420x300 clamp before adding more depth.

findings.area: status and direction read without explanation
findings.observation: The square red status chip with the exclamation glyph identifies the single failure, and causal filaments carry a small arrowhead at the target end. Corners are square (0px radius) and the one severity channel is consistent across cards. No legend is needed for these two signals.
findings.reproduce: page.goto('/?shot=cockpit'); inspect '#attention' and the arrowed ribbon ending at the 'read' card; grammar gate app/pi/tests/grammar.spec.ts:41.

findings.observation: The five lens controls (DETAIL, INNER, SIGNALS, ACTIONS, PIN) measure 44-59px wide and 44px tall; tabs switch the inspector and the connector remains visible when pinned. Placement is a separate finding (AUDIT-04); the controls themselves are reachable.
findings.reproduce: page.goto('/?shot=node-detail'); measure '#focus-lens .inspector-tabs button' and '#inspector-pin' rects; see app/pi/tests/grammar.spec.ts:135.

findings.observation: With '#canvas' focused, '/' opens the palette, ':' switches to commands, '?' to help, and Escape closes it; modes reported by __pi.commandMode() were palette, commands, help in that order. The command input also runs a named command.
findings.reproduce: page.goto('/?shot=cockpit'); page.locator('#canvas').focus(); press '/', ':', '?', 'Escape' and read __pi.commandMode(); see app/pi/tests/shell.spec.ts:133.

findings.observation: The transcript stays readable in side, stacked and collapsed floating arrangements; toggling and resizing are reachable from HUD controls, and the collapsed panel keeps a labelled 'Transcript' affordance on the canvas. The floating shot gives the graph the full field without hiding the panel.

With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, matchMedia matches and a traverseEdge flight reaches the final camera center and a settled simulation within 150ms. No intermediate drift or stuck animation was observed. Camera framing can differ from the normal flight by design (TODO6 invariant 10).
findings.reproduce: page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: 'reduce' }); page.goto('/?shot=cockpit'); call __pi.traverseEdge(__pi.edges()[0].id); read __pi.viewport() and __pi.simulation().settled after 150ms; see app/pi/tests/grammar.spec.ts:178.

findings.area: wide fit legibility and field vocabulary
findings.shot: fit-wide-far, fit-wide-mid, fit-wide-near, aurora-map, neon-cockpit, dynamic-range
findings.observation: On the wide canvas all three octaves keep labels and topology legible: the far octave reads as topology by core LOD, mid and near keep card text. No rounded rectangles, fog, backdrop-filter or blend modes appear in the shots; the field is gradient-based (opacity 0.56 dark, 0.14 light). Dynamic-range cards clip at the canvas edge at the scale floor, which is expected for that shot.
findings.reproduce: page.goto('/?shot=fit-wide-mid'); inspect '#field' computed opacity and '#canvas [data-rung]' border radius; compare the three wide fit PNGs.

cockpit.note: Dark field and square cards read cleanly; adds cross-unit diagonal finding AUDIT-05.

node-detail.note: Detail rung is legible; adds lens-occlusion finding AUDIT-04.

deep-focus.note: Large focused card and lens controls read; no new finding.

fractal.note: Directed inner spokes read; inner labels remain small as in AUDIT-07.

dense-type.note: Denser cards fit; labels truncate on width as in AUDIT-03.

living-graph.note: Longer activity tail does not add occlusion; no new finding.

recursion.note: Structure is bounded, but depth-3 inner chip names are not legible in the PNG (AUDIT-07).

dynamic-range.note: Edge clipping at the scale floor is expected for this shot; flux edges remain distinguishable.

layout-stacked.note: Transcript below the canvas keeps the descent spine visible.

layout-floating.note: Collapsed panel gives the field the full canvas without losing the affordance.

neon-cockpit.note: Emissive palette keeps cards legible; no new finding.

aurora-map.note: Full-scope filaments and rings remain distinguishable.

light-theme.note: Cards and edges read, but the HUD readout has 1.1:1 contrast over the dark canvas (AUDIT-01).

catalog.note: Drawer leaves the graph visible and fit intact; adds small hit-target finding AUDIT-02.

policy.note: Provenance panel reads; graph labels truncate as in AUDIT-03.

fit-wide-far.note: Topology-only core LOD at the scale floor.

fit-wide-mid.note: Cards and labels fit inside the aspect-derived insets.

fit-wide-near.note: Near octave keeps detail legible; intended child-card lane packing only.

fit-narrow-far.note: Topology-only core LOD; two-row header noted in AUDIT-06.

fit-narrow-mid.note: Graph fits, but labels truncate (AUDIT-03) and the header wraps (AUDIT-06).

fit-narrow-near.note: No gate regression, but parent/child card occlusion and truncation are visible (AUDIT-03).

triage.method: Grouped by root cause, ranked severity x confidence, filtered against TODO6 section 2 invariants; default budget of at most three fixes per change set.
triage.user_decision: 2026-11-22: implement all four medium/high findings (AUDIT-01, 02, 03, 04) in one change set.

AUDIT-01.contract: In both themes the #hud readout uses a light grayscale canvas text token with >=4.5:1 contrast over #050a12; gate: shell.test.ts contrast assertion + light-theme shot verdict.

AUDIT-02.contract: Every #catalog .catalog-card > summary has a >=44px square hit area with a visible square marker; gate: browser assertion + catalog shot verdict.

AUDIT-04.contract: The unpinned focus lens is biased into free canvas space so it does not overlap its source card by more than a small connector margin; gate: browser overlap assertion + node-detail shot verdict.

AUDIT-03.contract: At mid/near octaves on the 900px canvas, packed parent cards keep a reserved primary-label lane so role labels are not truncated to ambiguous fragments; gate: browser assertion on scrollWidth/visible width plus fit shot verdicts and vision gates.

AUDIT-05.reason: Low and explicitly accepted in TODO6 section 1. Bundling or scope tinting is a new visual contract requiring ADR 0008; preserve the relation, defer.

AUDIT-06.reason: Low space cost only; status text is not clipped. Command-bar reflow is outside the three-finding budget.

AUDIT-07.reason: Low, opt-in depth-3 preset. Enlarging the inner lens or adding hover reveal needs a new visual comparison; defer.

triage.status: closed: four accepted findings fixed and gated; rejected findings deferred with reasons

fixes.implementation: Added a light grayscale canvasText token to both HUD themes; #hud reads it. Measured light-theme contrast over #050a12 rose from 1.1:1 to 17.72:1.
Catalog summaries use a 44px minimum height, square bordered surface and padding; measured minimum row height rose from 18px to 44px.

labelFontPx reserves the monospace glyph width plus 8% card padding; portal glyph width is counted in the label length. No anatomy-title truncation remains in fit-narrow-mid/near, dense-type or policy.
The unpinned lens measures the focused node DOM card and picks the first free-space candidate (below, above, right, left) before clamping; the node-detail source card is no longer covered.
